text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A month after my mentor announced his retirement.
...There was something that had been on my mind the entire time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—We learned from him.
And so, we inherited his deepest wish—the dream of claiming three weight divisions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: But is simply conquering all three divisions truly enough?
choice_data_list: (As her apprentice, isn't there something I should be doing?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Umamusume First' approach my mentor cherished so deeply.
What he was striving for beyond that was—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To build a happy future for the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Gran-san.
Do you have a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what is it,
Dia-san?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Gran-san's Trainer was sitting in the back seat,
deep in thought with a troubled look on their face, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Aw man, again?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that all?
Aren't you worried about your Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's probably related to their retirement, so...
Ah, but I guess I am a little curious.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Or rather, running 3 miles left me feeling fuzzy.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Dia-san, do you know a lot about Valentine's Day?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, every single chocolate is so cute!
It's a Sparkling 5 Miles♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please let me know
if any of the chocolates catch your fancy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's call over the pastry chef
and have them give us a lesson on how to make it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I get to learn from a pro!
Ehehe, Trainer's gonna be so surprised!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah! Isn't that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having finished my paperwork, I head to the break room for a breather. It's unusually crowded and lively.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hello there,
Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman and Tazuna-san
gave chocolates to the Trainers."
choice_data_list: Whoa! This many— is it for everyone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Boxes of luxurious-looking chocolates
were stacked high on the table!
choice_data_list: Thank you, I'll gladly accept!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must thank Chairwoman Akikawa
and Tazuna-san later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training,
as I was compiling the data collected today—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness, you haven't left yet!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
would you like to take a break and refresh with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brought out under the promise of 'refreshment'—
we arrived at a bone-chilling training ground.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Please wait 0.001 miles!
I'll get something warm ready for you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, here you are!
choice_data_list: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cupping the warm mug in both hands, I take a sip right away.
A rich, gentle sweetness spreads throughout my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not too sweet, with a faint aroma of milk.
A touch of bitterness at the very end tightens up the aftertaste.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Taking a sip or two,
a soothing warmth spread from the core of my body."
choice_data_list: Is this... chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hot chocolate, ready! It's a winter staple in my family♪
choice_data_list: Is that your personal rule for winter?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No. Personal rules aside,
it's simply my absolute favorite chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "—Since it's a special occasion, I wanted you to taste my favorite chocolate too, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
…………Trainer.
You don't understand why it's chocolate, do you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Today is! Valentine's Day!!
choice_data_list: ――Ahh!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Whoa~, that is the face of someone who genuinely hadn't noticed!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the whole academy was exchanging chocolates!
Ah, don't tell me you were lost in your thoughts again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, my mind was so completely occupied
with Master's retirement that I failed to notice..."
choice_data_list: (So even these chocolates are for Valentine's Day, huh!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Well, that does sound like Trainer, though...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you weren't expecting anything from me.
Mmph.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: She might be 76 miles angry.
choice_data_list: S-sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: 76 miles per hour was substantial. I had no words to offer in return... Prompted by her gaze, I took a sip of the hot chocolate.
choice_data_list: This is really easy to drink. Just the way I like it.
This is really easy to drink. Just the way I like it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right!
I was really particular about balancing the flavors!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Just as you know me so well, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "I understand Trainer just as well as anyone else, you know!"
choice_data_list: ...Is that so...!
...So that's how it was...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Even Dia-san could see it clearly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. ...The last time I saw you,
you were struggling to decide what kind of refreshments to bring.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You seem quite confident about what would make Trainer happy right now, don't you?♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So, I know that you've been
deep in thought lately, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...The training my master taught me,
and the mindset that goes with it."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Just accepting it isn't enough, right?!
choice_data_list: We have to carry the torch forward after our time!
We have to carry the torch forward after us!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So let's think together
about how we can pass it along!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If we put our heads together,
I'm sure we'll come up with a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So with that, time for a sugar recharge.
Here, have some seconds!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"This crisp winter air
really clears your head, doesn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, Gran Alegria and I
explored various different methods.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No specific plan comes to mind just yet. But confirming
that our hearts are aligned was a massive step forward.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Actually, there's one more present!
choice_data_list: Wait, besides the chocolate...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes. Please take this♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Here's a Paka Petit Grand!
Here you go!
choice_data_list: Did you win this at the arcade for me?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes. I got it on the first try!
choice_data_list: Amazing! I'm so jealous of that skill...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you always get lost in thought.
So this little one is going to be your supervisor.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you ever have any worries,
please consult me or this little one, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Worrying about anything other than me is a no-no, okay?
Otherwise, I'll get all sulky for three whole miles.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Paka Petit Grand will solve your problems!
Just kidding! ☆
choice_data_list: You're a cute yet dependable supervisor.
You're a cute yet dependable supervisor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, looking at a smiling Paka Petit is both soothing and uplifting.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Please love and cherish me for a long time to come!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's the "Instant Knockout Sound Sleep Pillow"!
Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you often work late into the night,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Pushing yourself too hard isn't good for you, so please take naps from time to time!
choice_data_list: Gran...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Come on, give it a try!
5 miles feels amazing♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My heart full of Gran Alegria's kindness, I lay down to rest.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's delicious!
choice_data_list: You made hot chocolate for me again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought the mug to my lips.
It was rich, with a bitterness that overpowered any sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, really!
You're supposed to dip the churro into this hot chocolate to eat it!
choice_data_list: Churros?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: You said when you come to Spain, you have to try the local specialties, right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Was that how it went...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We're gonna eat churros, jamón,
paella, and tortilla, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're awake.
choice_data_list: —Ah! It was just a dream... Wow, talk about falling asleep instantly!
—Ah! It was just a dream... Wow, talk about falling asleep instantly!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: What kind of dream were you having?
choice_data_list: I was eating churros in Spain with you.
I was eating churros with you in Spain.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: With me?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, please always keep your head
completely full of thoughts about me.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If I get caught up thinking about other stuff,
those 3 miles will just feel all hazy and indistinct.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
For anything else, don't hesitate to consult me right away!
We'll figure it out together. Okay?
